query: Civiqs daily tracker Trump job approval

results.content:
Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of August 19, leaving him significantly underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. The survey has garnered 124,759 responses since January 20, 2025, when Trump was inaugurated for a second term. [...] According to the Civiqs poll, Trump has the highest net approval rating in Wyoming, where 56 percent of voters approve of his performance and 35 disapprove—giving him a net approval rating of +22 when rounding up.

results.content: Civiqs has been tracking this since the day Trump took the oath, and as of late July, Trump’s net approval in Texas sits at -13. Texas is one of eleven states Trump carried by double digits in 2024 where he’s now underwater, in the “should have been safe but isn’t” column.

results.content:
In May, a poll of 875 likely voters conducted by Keloland Media Group and Emerson College showed Trump with a 53% approval rating, while 42% disapproved.

Civiqs estimated that 51% of South Dakotans approved of Trump’s job performance as of Aug. 11.

This fact brief responds to claims such as this one.
